comments.body_html:
Thank you for bringing this awesome mod back to life.

I have some ideas/challanges for you that you could try implementing:

Configurable chance in % that the support gets shot down by anti air, after which you cant call any other support in that raid. (Tarkov is a no fly zone, except the airdrop plane.)

Better exfil helicopter. Meaning: If there is enough room for it, the heli should land and open its doors, while the player has to get inside the heli to be extracted. (Time to extract would be much shorter)
If there isnt enough room for landing, the heli should open its doors above the marked LZ and drop a ladder. The extract would be same as it is now, but it would look much better. (Time to extract would be longer)

Make use of smoke grenades: If the player marks the LZ only with the rangefinder, the heli would land/hover somewhere in a 50m radius (Configurable). But if the player throws a smoke grenade after calling the extract, the heli will come exactly at the spot where the smoke is.

Increase the bullet spread of the A10: As of now, i think the spread is really tight.

Gunship support: Already mentioned in the comments. Would love to see that.

Paid supports: Already mentioed in the comments. Would “balance” things out.

Of course, this is NOT a demand, simply a suggestion. It may be over the top, but it would be awesome to see these in the future.

comments.author: SaintMellec
comments.body_html:
I love this mod and love the spirit of insurgency that it brings. A bunch of my friends who I play with and I used to play insurgency so it feels like such a welcome return.

I had an idea I wanted to share.

To make calling in fire support more of a significant and special thing, what if there’s a cost system? But not money.

For the A10 strafe, it should cost one GP coin. Those were kind of pointless anyhow, but just rare enough that finding one in raid means you get to rain hell on somebody. Also, it takes some premeditation to bring one with you if you intend to use it.

For the heli extract, I think it should cost a Labs key card. The extract feels like one of the most potentially op things, and trading access to lab for an emergency exfil seems like a sound trade-off.

I think both of these things are more lore friendly and balanced than having a limited number of uses per raid.

Your thoughts?

Also I’m really sorry I killed your namesake PMC on factory last night.

Hey Arys,

you made it pretty clear you don’t have much time anymore, so as ambiguous as it is, i thought of sharing an idea for a 4th support, in the event you happen to have an abundance of time,

That’s all, and thanks for the amazing mod!
